# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/).

- Run repository quality scripts before proposing or finalizing changes.
- Keep shell, Python, PowerShell, and workflow files lint-clean; no suppressions.
- Enforce 140-character maximum line length for non-Markdown text.
- Keep CI and local quality checks equivalent.
- Preserve ≥90% coverage; update `assets/coverage.svg` locally when regenerating coverage.
